title: I finally travelled to the 'True End', and all I got was this fucking staircase.
physical_identity: An antique brutalist spiral staircase in black and white that only goes up, under a blinding ceiling light that never gets closer, in complete silence.
scale_topology: Confined area; endless in the upward direction by loop.
anomalies: Infinite ascent that returns the climber to the start
lighting_sound: Blinding light on the ceiling; black and white palette; total silence apart from heartbeat and breath.
hazards: none per source ('there is no danger')
